revised_result_semantics.after_excluding_cohort_wallets_from_outc: +63.9% non-cohort buyer-count contrast before launch-quality matching
revised_result_semantics.matched_SOL_inflow_lift: +6.3%, 95% CI approximately [-0.5%, +15.1%], not distinguishable from zero
revised_result_semantics.activity_matched_placebo: Biased diagnostic, not a valid causal baseline; do not use its larger lift as proof for or against economic alpha.

what_it_can_answer: Which wallets repeatedly appear together among first buyers across launches?
How recurrent and synchronized are persistent early-buyer cohorts?
Does cohort-touched status associate with downstream non-cohort buyer flow after explicit contamination exclusion and launch-quality matching?
How much of naive apparent wallet edge can disappear after proper causal hygiene?
what_it_cannot_yet_answer: Whether a cohort buy produces a sellable 5x/10x return for an observer entering at a frozen signal time.
Whether cohort members themselves have positive realizable PnL after fees/slippage across prior matured launches.
Whether wallets in a cohort are independent economic entities rather than same-funder/controller infrastructure.
Whether the June 2026 result generalizes to later Pump incentive/mechanics regimes or other chains.

joinability_probe.mint_or_launch_identity: The intra-launch source data is described as first-buyer-window data per launch and is expected to support launch identity reconstruction. Exact released schema must be inspected before code-level joins are authorized.
joinability_probe.wallet_identity: Cohort catalogue explicitly contains wallet membership; one vanity prefix is partially redacted in the public release, so exact traceability for that address is intentionally incomplete.
joinability_probe.event_timing: The study extracts first-ten buyer order/time/commitment information. Exact timestamp field semantics must be read from the released intra JSON and code before using for point-in-time feature construction.
joinability_probe.economic_outcome: No sellable-return outcome is established by the published buyer-flow analysis. A separate exact-mint outcome source or native chain reconstruction is required.
joinability_probe.entity_adjustment: Not sufficient from the paper alone. Add same-funder/controller/bundle/router evidence from independent sources before calling cohort wallets independent.

next_execution: Download and hash the current v1.1.1 release in a bounded research runner.
Inspect README, sniper_cohorts_intra schema and PSM code before assuming field names or timestamp semantics.
Build a mint/cohort/wallet/event-time normalized table with original source rows retained.
Search for an exact-mint outcome source covering the same June 11-25 window. Prefer native event/trade reconstruction over vendor chart peaks.
If a compatible outcome join is found, preregister an observer-entry timestamp and compute sellable 2x/5x/10x plus MFE/MAE/liquidity survival without using future cohort knowledge.
If no compatible economic join exists, stop retrospective economic inference and use RED-COHORT only to define prospective G3 structural features.
promotion_guardrail: RED-COHORT can improve the definition of clean G3 immediately, but cannot promote G3 weight until economic-return and entity-adjusted evidence exists.
